description.fun: A walking Stonehenge that spends its life watching the sun cross the sky. Once a year, on a set date and time, Stonjourner appear out of nowhere and stand together in a circle, and nobody knows why. Its rock matches the bedrock of a faraway land, which seems a nod to Stonehenge's bluestones, brought from the mountains of Wales.
description.guide: A Rock-type Pokémon based on Stonehenge, from Pokémon Sword and Shield. Stonjourner watch the sun and gather in a ring once a year. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A living stone circle that watches the sun
